previousIssues.issue: w13a MEDIUM / w13b LOW: blackout pleats read as thin grooves on flat slats, not alternating pleat facets
previousIssues.status: partly fixed (character better, contrast not). The ramp tile changed the close-up profile from a notch on flat crests (w13 col 300: 160 156 118 95 150 164 166 166 163 157 140 101) to a soft corduroy (w14: 104 125 150 163 171 173 171 168 136 104). That is a graded lit face, a crest, then a short fall. Dark fraction (below mean) went 0.37 -> 0.41, against about 0.5 in omaat_room24. Amplitude did not move: cv 0.166 (w13 0.165), p5/p95 0.58 (0.57), against the photo's 0.35 / 0.38. The photo's room24 profile is close to a two-level square wave (dark faces 80-100 for ~14 px, lit faces 150-200 for ~13 px, period ~29 px). It now reads as a soft pleated blind, not a ruled panel, and it matches omaat_room38 at mid distance. It still lacks room24's grazing-light punch (ra14/pleat_cmp.png: w13 | w14 | room24). Downgraded to low.

previousIssues.issue: w13a LOW: door viewing window ~15-20% small and set low; shade tab undersized
previousIssues.status: partly fixed. The reveal is now 0.26 x 0.58 m. In s06 it runs from row 286 to 358, with its top level with the handle-housing top, where w13's sat below it. Glass rows are 294-354. Against the housing the window is ~1.1x the box height, where lalf_133 shows ~1.4x. The thin bar is now a cream shade pulled 0.32 of the glass (rows 294-312 of 294-354), against ~0.25 in lalf_133. But the dark finger slot does not render. Neither b_doorWin nor s06 has any dark pixel on the shade (b_doorWin rows 399-441 read a flat 225-228). The code places the slot box at local z -0.003, and windowFrame's local +z is the inboard normal, so the 4 mm slot box sits behind the shade's inboard face at +0.003 and is hidden. The shade reads 226 in s06, the same as the lining (227), so at aisle distance the opening reads as a tall lining-coloured frame with glass only in the lower two thirds (ra14/s06_pair.png, sbs_s07_door4L.png). The window also nearly touches the housing (gap ~1 px at s06, against ~0.1 of the box width in lalf_133).

details.detail: Sidewall panels and seams. Unchanged: clean satin, seams every second window. Still no linen weave (tt_window).
F/J short bowl and LED pill. Unchanged and right. The pill is 0.089 of the pane width (photo ~0.084-0.094).
PY/Y full-height tub and raised bezel. Unchanged in the shell. The lip band is lighting's; there is a faint floor card.
Pane tunnel lining and seal. Unchanged and right.

Electric shades. Tone unchanged and right: 0.606 of the wall, B-R -13 (room24 0.57, -16). The ramp tile turned the ruled-groove look into a soft corduroy pleat that matches omaat_room38 at mid distance, and the far beat bands are more even. Close-up amplitude is still half of room24 under grazing light (cv 0.166 vs 0.35), and the pleat is a rounded ramp, not the photo's crisp two-tone facets. The sheer is unchanged.

Manual PY/Y shades. s08 is unchanged in the shell (diff 0.06). The studio win_front frame is broken this round: it shows a cabin view instead of the studio wall, which is a harness problem, so the check relies on s08 only.

Dado, grilles and placards. The louvres are now legible (cv 0.21 vs 0.10), which helps at seat distance. The grille field is a touch light against the dado (0.82 vs photo ~0.68), and the louvre pitch is finer than py_37303's.
Door / galley vinyl. Unchanged: hue right, fine speckle low.

Type A door surround and viewing window. Larger (0.26 x 0.58), with its top now level with the housing top, and it now has its own shade. Still ~1.1x the housing height against ~1.4x in lalf_133. The finger slot is invisible (it is buried behind the shade face). The shade is the lining's exact tone, so at aisle distance the window reads as a tall cream frame with a short glass. The window abuts the handle housing with no gap.

issues.detail: Door window finger slot does not render (buried behind the shade face)
issues.problem: Commit 06f9c5a adds a dark 0.05 x 0.008 slot, but no dark pixel appears on the shade in b_doorWin (rows 399-441 flat 225-228) or s06. windowFrame's local +z is the inboard normal (origin = wall - N*depth). The slot box at local z -0.003 (thickness 0.004) spans -0.005..-0.001, behind the shade's inboard face at +0.003.
issues.evidence: 07_shell.js line ~667: M4.mul(tabF, M4.trs(0, -0.05, -0.003)). b_doorWin column samples; ra14/doorwin_pair.png.
issues.fix: Change the slot offset to M4.trs(0, -0.05, +0.004) so it sits proud of the inboard face, or make it a recess with a dark inset. Also tint the shade slightly (e.g. #e2ddd2 against MAT.door) or give it a 3 mm darker hem, so it separates from the lining at aisle distance as in lalf_133.
